titles.title: SAFER Meat, Poultry, and Food Act of 2006

A bill to amend the Federal Meat Inspection Act, the Poultry Products Inspection Act, and the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to provide for improved public health and food safety through enhanced enforcement, and for other purposes.
SAFER Meat, Poultry, and Food Act of 2006
Safer and Fair Enforcement and Recall for Meat, Poultry, and Food Act of 2006
